name: Clissold Park Playground
description: Natural-style play area opened in 2011 as part of the park's restoration, with swaying wooden bridges, hollow logs, climbing boulders, tractor-tyre swings, a desert-island sand valley and water play, plus a climbing web, swings, springers and roundabouts for smaller children. The Wheels Park next door has jumps and mounds for skateboards, scooters and BMX.

nearby.label: No car park; limited street parking nearby

sources.label: Hackney Council: fun in the sun at the new Clissold Park play area
